summary: Defines a static class RoleConstants containing string constants representing different roles: PC, NIS, IRP, RC, DC.
purpose: To provide centralized, type-safe string identifiers for various application roles in a .NET namespace.
system_behavior: Provides named constants for referencing roles throughout the HSPnet.UI application.
content_gaps: No descriptions provided for what each role (PC, NIS, IRP, RC, DC) stands for or their specific application functionality.
